published_title: Show the Rebel Fleet No Mercy
byline: Darth Vader "The Dark" Lord of The Sith
player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''The Dark''') posted a [[Dark]] list on DeckTech in August 2001.
description: This deck is a deck I created about a year ago and have been tinkering  wit it until today, I submit it for your review. It's based on Combat Responses, which lets you pull matching pilots and starfighters down.

notes: The byline 'Darth Vader "The Dark" Lord of The Sith' is a prank name; the deck is credited to the DeckTech handle The Dark as plain text (no player page), as with his other DeckTech decks (e.g. 18120, 18156, 18194, 18394).

No Objective. Starting cards as marked '- STARTING' in the post: Kessel (the starting location), Prepared Defenses, and the three effects it deploys, Something Special Planned For Them, Mobilization Points and Combat Response; these count toward the 60. No single starting effect is set because Prepared Defenses deploys all three.
Posted 4 August 2001. Coruscant here is the Dark Special Edition system (Coruscant (Dark) (Special Edition)), not a Coruscant-set card, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.
The deck totals 61 as published. The section headers do not all match the lists (Starships 23 vs 24 listed, Effects 5 vs 6).
Posted 'CC Boba Fett' dested Boba Fett (Cloud City).

Generic systems and weapon dested to the Dark pages: Kessel (Dark), Bespin (Dark), Dantooine (Dark), Ord Mantell (Dark), Yavin 4 (Dark), Endor (Dark), Hoth (Dark), Tatooine (Dark) (Premiere), Heavy Turbolaser Battery (Dark).
Posted 'all Power to the Weapons' dested All Power To Weapons; 'Slave 1' dested Slave I.
The strategy mentions Vader's Custom TIE, but it is not in the list; the list is kept as published.
